originality.rationale: Underlying bipartite adjacency sign switching is classical; it is not claimed as a new graph lemma. The specific result applies that structural criterion to the exact multiband BCS linearized operator and physically meaningful critical-temperature/threshold symmetry at arbitrary coupling. The source HLL Proposition 1.4 explicitly allows asymmetric positive/negative thresholds and discusses sign dependence for at least three bands, but the inspected full original does not state the bipartite graph all-coupling criterion. Other GL and isotropic matrix models differ in assumptions. The particular operator-specific statement was not found already implied by the inspected literature.
